content: Hex official docs state mix hex.publish publishes a new version, --yes removes prompts, --dry-run builds and performs local checks without publishing, --replace can overwrite only inside the allowed window for public packages, and --revert can revert a version. Hex FAQ states the repository is immutable in general, with 60-minute release-version and 24-hour initial-package exceptions, and recommends retire instead of unpublishing for normal public-package recovery.
